_about: Places, factions, concepts and hidden texts of the Aeon's End setting, reconstructed from wiki lore. 'confidence': canon = stated in a lore text; inferred = deduced from several texts.

places.name: Gravehold
places.summary: An ancient, haunted underground citadel built by the troggs as a sanctuary from the primordial chaos. In The World That Was the corrupted 'descended to Gravehold' when they gave up their names. Brama's people claimed it after the Calamity and lived there for generations until The Fall; its ruins later flooded.
features: dirt market paved with tumbled breach glass
Chasmwalk, where beggars cry 'The end is near!'

places.name: The Depths
places.summary: The infinite tunnels and vaults below Gravehold: where the troggs slept, where the dead are thrown because dirt is too precious to bury them, where husk carcasses are heaped, where the Ordeal tests young mages and where Kadir seeks a sleeping god and a shadow city older than time.
features: piles of husks reaching the vault
shafts outside Chasmwalk used for the final trial

places.name: The Cragbellows / Craghollows
places.summary: Ruined district of Gravehold where masked mages practised blood magic — Xaxos' secret circle and the Hollow Crown's acolytes.

places.name: New Gravehold
places.summary: Surface city founded after The Fall, with walls twice as high as the old ones, farms, archives rescued from the ruins, a Council of Elders and a ring of outposts. Its expansion pushes Portalborn south toward Azer.

places.name: Southpost
places.summary: New Gravehold's southern outpost, where Talix grew up (his mother was its leader). Razed by Necroswarm, later rebuilt.

places.name: Northern Outpost
places.summary: Remote outpost run by Soskel, where Mazra took a sabbatical.

places.name: Sunken Old Gravehold
places.summary: Years of rain flooded the tunnels abandoned in The Fall. Gygar dives there with Kadir's air spell; aquatic Nameless (the Fortress) have taken over, and surviving mages live in air pockets.

places.name: Azer
places.summary: A southern forest village older than New Gravehold whose mages fight in Tethered pairs, use sigils to keep breaches few and little magic to avoid roving Portalborn.

places.name: The Void
places.summary: The mirror dimension beyond the breaches and home of the Nameless. Its air is poison and madness, time runs wrong (some stay young for centuries, others age in moments), yet it holds forests, roads, swamps and even a city — perhaps pieces of our world consumed and twisted. Seen with loving eyes it is beautiful: iridescent sky, floating mountains thin as bones, gems blooming like flowers.

places.name: The Black Mausoleum
places.summary: The Conclave's sepulchre of eternal sleep, where Yan Magda was entombed for questioning their ways.

places.name: Erythiza
places.summary: Great city of scientists with the Royal Erythiza Academy and a prestigious university. Kiri Maesan came from there. It vanished in the great calamity and its people became Nameless in an instant.

places.name: Karek
places.summary: A shining brass port city by the ocean, home of the First Tribe's archive of 'millions of years' of knowledge. Turned to a mountain of green glass by the Blight Lord.

places.name: M'hlark
places.summary: Harbor towns frozen in glass after Karek fell.

places.name: Port Hanon
places.summary: Coastal city with a City Guard that subdues the corrupted; built on a Nameless burial ground.

places.name: Azrius
places.summary: One of the towering cities of the ancient texts, alongside Erythiza and Karek.

places.name: V'riswood
places.summary: Ancient towering trees whose amber is all that remains.

places.name: Donnyton
places.summary: A town rebuilt by a small group of women; mocked by the Sisterhood elders. Its fate is The Coven.

places.name: The Monastery Caverns
places.summary: Frozen gem-lined caverns of monks who teach five steps to enlightenment; Quilius and Alcheia come from there.

places.name: The Henge / the mountain
places.summary: Home of the henge mystics; Mazahaedron's mountain was once a volcano.

places.name: Souston
places.summary: A peaceful future town protected by head woman Camellia's glyph carving.

places.name: Faen
places.summary: Swamp village east of Souston; long ago a monster turned its Tethers against each other and Shoshana's great-grandmothers fled.

places.name: Cindercrown
places.summary: Future city of 'indestructible' iron walls ruled by the Regi; Upper Crowners live without Nameless while Strike teams patrol below.

places.name: The System
places.summary: Sealed pipe-tunnels beneath Cindercrown where Nameless are contained; scouts gather phosphor nuggets from the pipes.

places.name: Mynerva
places.summary: A world from a digital crossover promo whose Guild sends Xae through a portal to Gravehold. Not part of the main canon.

factions.name: The Sisterhood (conclaves of sisters)
factions.summary: Nomadic clans led by elders and sisters who speak the sister-words; men and non-speakers are 'Followers'. Its elders consider permanence hubris. The conclaves split over going underground.

factions.name: The Followers
factions.summary: Hunters, fathers, alchemists and healers who keep the Sisterhood fed but are belittled by it.

factions.name: The First Tribe
factions.summary: Archivists of Karek who would not abandon their knowledge; frozen in green glass when they knelt to the Blight Lord. Raven and Xaxos are its last.

factions.name: The Breach Mages of Gravehold
factions.summary: Defenders who weaponise breaches. Ranks: youngling, initiate, apprentice, mage, elder, high elder; offices of dagger captain and breach commander. Veterans bear an ankle tattoo.

factions.name: Council of Elders
factions.summary: Senior mages governing Gravehold and New Gravehold, led by Brama. Debates endlessly; hides inconvenient truths 'to avoid chaos'.

factions.name: Followers of Xaxos
factions.summary: Students and sympathisers of Xaxos' Void research, exiled to the woods. They wear his insignia, release captured Nameless, and some become Nameless themselves.

factions.name: Acolytes of the Hollow Crown
factions.summary: Former mages who practised blood magic in the Craghollows and now serve the Crown masked: Edryss Tragg, Holadran, Kurgax, Lurzan, Mord, Nhavkalas, Ren-Goda, Solara, Bezu.

factions.name: Yan Magda's cadre of Void orphans
factions.summary: Exiles gathered in the spiral of worlds: Garu, Dezmodia, Kain, Remnant. Distrusted as heretics, they save Gravehold against the Prophet.

factions.name: The Conclave
factions.summary: An ancient order that does not believe in killing; it sentenced Yan Magda to eternal sleep. It worshipped at a great tower and reveres a child 'risen from the dust', the first of their kind.

factions.name: The Monks of the Caverns
factions.summary: Ascetics teaching five steps to enlightenment through the kill.

factions.name: Henge Mystics
factions.summary: Mystics who hear the world as a living mother; Mazahaedron never lets his feet touch the earth.

factions.name: Mages of Azer (Tethers)
factions.summary: Paired mages (source and sink) bound by tattoos; they ally with Z'hana in the civil war.

factions.name: Royal Erythiza Academy
factions.summary: Scientific institution whose head scientist's experiment with The Hunger triggered the Calamity.

factions.name: Port Hanon City Guard
factions.summary: Guards who beat back the feral corrupted.

factions.name: Strike teams of Cindercrown
factions.summary: Captain-and-scout teams that patrol the System, successors of the dagger captains; equipped by the Allocators from the treasury.

factions.name: The Bishop's army
factions.summary: Nameless collected across the Void by the Bishop of Scrolls, some pulled half-formed from the Fountain of Souls.

concepts.name: Aether
concepts.summary: The building block of life and magic, present in everything (the Azerian view) and concentrated in gems; the aether spilled by the Nameless became trapped in stones.

concepts.name: Void essence
concepts.summary: Xaxos' term for aether's opposite: concentrated entropy that breaks things down and turns living things into twisted reflections of themselves. Leaks through breaches; marks bodies with scales, claws, tendrils.

concepts.name: Breaches
concepts.summary: Tears in reality opened by rotating aether to 'dimensional velocity' — first learned from phoenixes. The Nameless travel through them; mages channel spells through up to four of their own.

concepts.name: The sister-words
concepts.summary: The mage's tongue, 'the language of all things', taught by Brama and once reserved to the Sisterhood. Exceptions prove the rule wrong: Janti, Thraxir, Xaxos' runes, Cairna's instinctive magic.

concepts.name: The Nameless (Portalborn, Voidlife)
concepts.summary: World-culling beings from the Void. Clues across eras: in the past, corrupted humans gave up their names; the Fountain of Souls reconstitutes the aether of fallen mages into Nameless; partly corrupted humans (Arachnos, the Bishop, Crooked Mask) can still speak. 'The Nameless do not die, for they themselves are death.'

concepts.name: Corruption
concepts.summary: The slow transformation of living things toward Nameless; inheritable (Xaxos' line), accelerated by Void exposure, culled in nature by phoenixes.

concepts.name: The Ordeal
concepts.summary: Mage initiation: learn the sister-words, fashion a personal gem, find your way back alone from the deep with Kadir's guidance, then slay a snared Void beast dropped down a shaft outside Chasmwalk.

concepts.name: Tethers
concepts.summary: Azerian practice of pairing mages as source and sink, marked with matching tattoos; love and weakness at once.

concepts.name: Glyphs, sigils and runes
concepts.summary: Aether drawn in patterns to steer small Void creatures (Azer, Souston) — or, with human aether, to lure and control great Nameless (Z'hana).

concepts.name: The Fall
concepts.summary: Name given (by Xaxos) to Gravehold's destruction by Maelstrom.

concepts.name: The Second Fall / The World To Come
concepts.summary: Mist's planned apocalypse to unite humanity.

concepts.name: Khasad Vol
concepts.summary: The forgotten true name of The World That Was, spoken aloud by Yan Magda.

concepts.name: The Fountain of Souls
concepts.summary: A living pool in the Void that absorbs aether crossing breaches; bubbles inside it are almost recognisable — souls.

concepts.name: Pulse magic
concepts.summary: Electric energy that began running through mages after the Legacy era, converted into charges.

secrets.title: The Anomaly confession (Legacy of Gravehold)
secrets.how: Flavor texts of the five Anomaly cards read in order Nihilum → Eternus → Photonix → Zeronia → Mechanek.
secrets.text: ...that I saw something in the Void when I experimented with it. There was a feeling that the very dimension itself was looking back through my breaches and seeing me, and trying to draw me further into it. I have never forgotten the way the air tasted, like a stolen breath while plummeting to my death. I still wake up in the middle of the night remembering

secrets.title: The crystal and spark riddles (Beyond the Breach)
secrets.how: Superior → Dim → Infused → Empty starter cards.
secrets.text: When you spend enough time looking in one direction, you think if you turn around you'll be losing something; it becomes harder and harder to imagine going back, but progress is progress, no matter your facing. / If you look the same person in the eye for long enough, you begin to forget what the rest of their face looks like. It is not betrayal to take a step back every now and again, and take in the truth of all your surroundings.

open_questions: Where did Maelstrom come from, and what reached out of the breach to take Xaxos?
Who were the heroes who contained Erythiza's corruption, and where did they put it?
Was Griefweaver once a mage of Gravehold?
Who was Lost before the armour, and whose corpse lay in the sealed forge?
Is Rip a Void creature — and is the silver beast of Lilly's mother the same Rip?
What is the Conclave, and where is the Black Mausoleum?
